name: 日程表の案件情報行
prompt:
Use case: text-localization / ui-mockup. LH09-0052 compact timeline project-information row.
Use ORIGINAL crop image2 as edit base; image1 context and image3 nearest-neighbor enlarged original show fine anatomy. ORIGINALS PRIMARY for every icon shape/stroke/optical weight, proportions, order, alignment, details and artwork. Image4 mock SECONDARY Japanese wording; do NOT copy its list icon, green dot, omitted yellow glyph or mint initial avatar.
Single compact horizontal row, logical300x60. In order: original thin outline HEADPHONE/project glyph; Japanese title「利用者体験の調査支援」in Meiryo Regular14/24, zero tracking; original empty DASHED circular indicator; original AMBER outlined circular progress glyph with its internal original mark; original THREE ascending gray priority bars; original black circular avatar with tiny original white artwork/wordmark. Preserve exact original avatar appearance/artwork, do not replace it with a person or initials and do not invent legible logo text. No new label or metric.
Original selected-row state indicated by rounded neutral hairline border and subtle restrained elevation; make row surface and outer canvas pure WHITE per official system. Keep title compact/readable, enough width to avoid losing Japanese meaning, body never bold or oversized. Utility glyphs slate #526173, empty dashed state neutral gray, amber marker retains its status distinction. No new green decorative accent or action/button/card nesting. Preserve all six original elements.
reviewNotes: Japanese title and all six source elements present; dashed state/amber progress/ascending priority distinctions restored, white row. Original black avatar artwork redrawn and amber internal glyph/stroke details drift; retain needs-correction without claiming logo fidelity.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
